borders.why: Links pairs of countries with the border Length on the link; points at country twice.

city.why: One row per city keyed by Name and Province with population and coordinates; located, locatedOn and organization point at it.

continent.why: Five continents keyed by Name with their Area, an amount that describes them; encompasses points at it.

country.why: One row per country keyed by Code with capital, area and population; nearly every table points at it.

desert.why: One row per desert keyed by Name with area and coordinates; geo_desert points at it.

economy.why: One row per country, keyed by Country, with GDP and sector shares: a one-to-one extension of country with no period.

encompasses.why: Links countries to continents with a Percentage on the link.

ethnicGroup.why: Links a country to an ethnic group name with a Percentage on the link; the group has no table of its own.

geo_desert.why: Links deserts to the provinces and countries they lie in; pointers only.

geo_estuary.why: Links rivers to the provinces and countries of their estuary; pointers only.

geo_island.why: Links islands to the provinces and countries they belong to; pointers only.

geo_lake.why: Links lakes to the provinces and countries they lie in; pointers only.

geo_mountain.why: Links mountains to the provinces and countries they lie in; pointers only.

geo_river.why: Links rivers to the provinces and countries they flow through; pointers only.

geo_sea.why: Links seas to the provinces and countries on their coast; pointers only.

geo_source.why: Links rivers to the provinces and countries of their source; pointers only.

isMember.why: Links countries to organizations with the membership Type on the link.

island.why: One row per island keyed by Name with area, height, type and coordinates; the island link tables point at it.

islandIn.why: Links islands to the sea, lake or river they sit in; pointers only.

lake.why: One row per lake keyed by Name with area, depth, altitude and coordinates; geo_lake, located and islandIn point at it.

language.why: Links a country to a language name with a Percentage on the link; the language has no table of its own.

located.why: Links cities to the river, lake or sea they stand on; pointers only.

locatedOn.why: Links cities to the islands they stand on; pointers only.

mergesWith.why: Links pairs of seas that merge; points at sea twice and nothing else.

mountain.why: One row per mountain keyed by Name with range, height, type and coordinates; geo_mountain and mountainOnIsland point at it.

mountainOnIsland.why: Links mountains to the islands they stand on; pointers only.

organization.why: One row per international organization keyed by Abbreviation with name, seat and Established, a business date.

politics.why: One row per country with independence date, dependency and government: a one-to-one extension of country.

population.why: One row per country with population growth and infant mortality: a one-to-one extension of country with no period.

province.why: One row per province keyed by Country and Name with population, area and capital; city and the geo tables point at it.

religion.why: Links a country to a religion name with a Percentage on the link; the religion has no table of its own.

river.why: One row per river keyed by Name with length and source and estuary coordinates; the geo river tables point at it.

sea.why: One row per sea keyed by Name with its Depth; geo_sea, located, islandIn and mergesWith point at it.

target.why: One row per country with a Christian/non-Christian label: a one-to-one extension of country added as a learning target.
